plugins.description: Moved to arnaud-zg/skills: run /plugin marketplace add arnaud-zg/skills, then /plugin install arnaud-zg@arnaud-zg-skills. Arnaud Zheng's Agent Skills. hexagonal-skill-builder writes Agent Skills and checks them against four rules a script can hold: named, small, resolves, tested. Every finding comes with its file, line and fix.
